correctness.rationale: For the generic homogeneous countable poset, a complete nonalgebraic ordered two-type over individually named finite parameters is exactly a realizable finite induced extension of those parameters by x,y. For fixed x<y or x||y, classify each parameter by its two ternary relations to x and y (6 or 7 admissible local states). All potential transitivity violations involve at most two parameters, so compatibility of within-level and A<B cross-level state pairs is necessary and sufficient. Enumeration of the finite compatible support pairs yields the 5x5 integer matrices in RESULT.md; substituting X=e^s-1 and Y=e^t-1 counts surjections from distinctly named parameters onto supports and evaluates C=4^a2^b+2^a4^b+3^(a+b)+3^a+3^b-2^(a+b)-2^(a+1)-2^(b+1)+1 and I=4^(a+b)+4^a+4^b+2(3^a2^b+2^a3^b)-4*2^(a+b)-2(2^a+2^b)+2. T=2C+I, with (0,0)=3, (1,1)=66, (2,2)=746; the 9^n vs 16^n leading terms yield 2(9/16)^n comparability. Independent direct transitivity enumeration of labelled extensions checked all 10 pairs a+b<=3; this finite test only corroborates the exact finite-support identity, not arbitrary a,b by itself.
